products.eyebrow: laser cut wood cross wall hanging
products.summary: This laser cut wood cross wall hanging comes in five color variants—black, brown, beige, coffee, and red. Its rustic finish and visible wood grain make it a versatile decorative piece for faith-based settings. Ideal for wholesale buyers sourcing religious craft items.
products.description:
This wall hanging is a laser cut wood cross, available in five distinct color finishes: black, brown, beige, coffee, and red. The exposed wood grain and clean cut lines give it a rustic, handmade look that suits both traditional and modern interiors.

Because the product is a plain cross without a corpus, it is not a crucifix. In Catholic devotion, such crosses are commonly displayed in homes, offices, and ministry spaces as visible symbols of faith.

For wholesale buyers, the five color options allow you to match different aesthetics or seasonal themes. The compact hanging design makes it easy to display on walls, doors, or above doorframes.

faq.answer: The bottle has a glass body and an outer container made of alloy, with an embossed design on the metal.

faq.question: How many finish and style options are available?
faq.answer: There are 34 variants, including gold and silver finishes across numbered designs from No. 1 to No. 17.

faq.question: Is this bottle suitable for everyday carrying?
faq.answer: The alloy outer shell helps protect the glass interior, making it practical for carrying holy water during daily use.
